# Research notes

Five interviews, September 2026.

1. Interview with Dana Whitfield (dana.whitfield@example.test). She starts a plan on Sunday but stops when she has to add recipes one by one. She said that she pastes recipe links into a chat with herself.
2. A parent of two. Plans each Sunday and finishes most weeks. Wants the shopping list in the order of the shop's aisles.
3. A student. Starts a plan, forgets it by Tuesday. Said that a reminder does not help, because the plan takes too long to fill.
4. A retired teacher. Copies recipes from websites by hand. Asked for a way to save a recipe from a link.
5. A nurse on shifts. Plans in short breaks. Gives up when adding a recipe takes more than a minute.
